title: EPA funding review: 3,768 obligated awards retain separate approval, cancellation, and litigation states
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named U.S. agencies
summary: GAO reports that EPA reviewed 3,768 obligated awards totaling $71.7 billion, approved 3,388 awards totaling $42.5 billion, canceled 372 IRA awards totaling about $9.2 billion, and treated eight grants totaling $19.97 billion as pending because of ongoing litigation. Denominator: EPA awards and dollars subject to the agency review; status data generally through February 25, 2026, with litigation status discussed through April 2026.
